resetPassword.question: [ES] How do I reset my password?
resetPassword.answer: [ES] Go to Settings → Security. Enter your current password, then the new one twice; the change takes effect immediately. If you've forgotten it, use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page and we'll email you a reset link.

updateInfo.question: [ES] How do I change my personal details?
updateInfo.answer: [ES] Go to Settings → Universal Information to update your name, date of birth, country/region of birth, passport details, phone number and address. Save each section separately. Applications already lodged with an authority are not updated automatically — tell support if something has changed.

startNewApplication.question: [ES] How do I start a new application without touching my existing one?
startNewApplication.answer: [ES] Open the Application tab. It asks first: continue one already in progress, or start a new one. Choosing “start a new application” and picking a destination leaves your existing applications untouched.

updatePayment.question: [ES] How do I pay, or change how I pay?
updatePayment.answer: [ES] Payment happens at checkout, and the available methods are shown before you confirm. We never ask for full card details over chat or email. Past payments, receipts and refund status live under Billing.

feeBreakdown.question: [ES] What am I actually paying for?
feeBreakdown.answer: [ES] Checkout lists the government fee and the VIZA service fee separately. The government fee is the destination's official charge and we don't mark it up; the service fee is what we charge for handling the application. They refund under different rules — see the refund policy.

processingTime.question: [ES] How long until the visa is issued?
processingTime.answer: [ES] The times shown are estimates based on past applications. The actual decision and its timing rest with the consulate or immigration authority — we can't influence that and we don't promise a date. Once it's lodged, Status shows each step as it happens.

dataPrivate.question: [ES] Is my application data safe?
dataPrivate.answer: [ES] It's stored and transmitted encrypted, and reachable only by you, authorised VIZA staff, and the providers needed to deliver the visa service. The Data usage article under Privacy and security has the detail.

contactSupport.question: [ES] How do I reach a person?
contactSupport.answer: [ES] Raise a request under Help → Contact, or email support@viza.it.com. We work Singapore business hours and usually reply within one business day.

completeYourProfile.title: [ES] Complete your profile
completeYourProfile.subtitle: [ES] Keep reusable applicant information accurate across your visa applications.

content.text: [ES] Your Universal Information profile stores applicant details that can be reused across visa applications. Keeping it accurate reduces duplicate entry and helps prevent inconsistencies in official forms.

items: [ES] Open Settings from the navigation menu.
[ES] Select Universal Information.
[ES] Review your identity, contact, passport, travel, and background details.
[ES] Save each section after making changes.

content.text: [ES] Enter names, dates, and passport details exactly as they appear on your travel documents.

items: [ES] Identity information, including your legal name, birth details, nationality, and gender.
[ES] Contact information, including your email, phone number, and current address.
[ES] Passport details and reusable supporting documents.
[ES] Travel, family, education, employment, and background details used by visa forms.

content.text: [ES] Email and password changes are handled in the Security section of Settings. Go to Settings → Security and follow the prompts to update your login credentials.

addPaymentMethod.metaTitle: [ES] Add a Payment Method | Help Center
addPaymentMethod.title: [ES] Add a payment method
addPaymentMethod.subtitle: [ES] How billing and payment work on the platform.

content.text: [ES] VIZA uses secure checkout for eligible application, subscription, and agency-fee payments. Available payment methods are shown before you confirm a purchase.

items: [ES] Open the application or subscription checkout you want to pay.
[ES] Review the amount, currency, and payment description.
[ES] Choose one of the payment methods offered at checkout and complete the provider's secure flow.

content.text: [ES] VIZA never asks you to send full card details through chat or email. Contact support if a checkout does not show the payment method you expect.
[ES] Eligible VIZA Points and their redemption options are shown in Points Center. Availability and limits vary by plan, promotion, and purchase type.
[ES] Open Billing to view payment history, receipts, invoice requests, and refund status.

exploreServices.title: [ES] Explore VIZA
exploreServices.subtitle: [ES] The tools available throughout your visa journey.

content.text: [ES] Start or continue an application from Home or the Application tab. VIZA keeps your answers, supporting documents, payments, consent, and status in one workflow.
[ES] Save reusable personal, passport, contact, travel, and background information once, then reuse it across supported visa applications.

items: [ES] Open Universal Information from Settings.
[ES] Review each category and upload reusable documents.
[ES] Save your changes before returning to an application.
[ES] Confirm prefilled answers inside each visa form before submission.

content.text: [ES] Use Visa AI to understand visa routes, requirements, and next steps. Once your route is clear, continue detailed data entry in the Application area.
[ES] For official requirements, rely on the source links shown by VIZA and ask support when something is uncertain.
[ES] Plan trips with Travel AI — destinations, dates, travellers, preferences, and itinerary ideas. Travel planning stays separate from your official visa application.
[ES] Use Status to follow application progress, and Support for account, payment, document, or timing questions that need a person.

accountSecurityTips.title: [ES] Account security tips
accountSecurityTips.subtitle: [ES] Keeping your account and personal data safe.

content.text: [ES] Choose a password that is long, unique, and hard to guess. Don't reuse a password from another service.

items: [ES] Use at least 12 characters.
[ES] Include uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols.
[ES] Store passwords in a trusted password manager if you can.

content.text: [ES] Never share your login details. Our support team will never ask for your password.
[ES] If you think your password has been exposed, change it straight away in Settings → Security.

items: [ES] Log out after using a shared or public device.
[ES] Don't save passwords in public browsers.
[ES] Avoid signing in from networks you don't know.

content.text: [ES] If you see unexpected account changes, failed-login alerts, or activity you don't recognise, contact support as soon as you can.

dataUsage.title: [ES] Data usage
dataUsage.subtitle: [ES] What data we collect, and what we do with it.

items: [ES] Personal information: name, date of birth, phone number, and address.
[ES] Application data: passport details, visa history, form answers, supporting documents, and consent records.
[ES] Usage data: pages visited, features used, and session activity, used to improve the platform.
[ES] Transaction data: payment status, invoices, refunds, and subscription records.
[ES] To prepare, review, and manage your visa applications.
[ES] To let authorised VIZA staff review application materials and support you.
[ES] To process payments and track service fulfilment.
[ES] To send you application, document, payment, and status notifications.

content.text: [ES] Your personal data is treated as confidential and is not sold to third parties.
[ES] Some functions rely on third-party providers for payments, document processing, communications, and official submission.
[ES] Only the minimum information needed to deliver the service is shared with them.

items: [ES] Ask for a copy of your account and personal data by contacting support.
[ES] Ask us to correct inaccurate profile details.
[ES] Ask for your account to be deleted, subject to visa and legal retention requirements.

twoFactorSupport.title: [ES] Two-factor authentication
twoFactorSupport.subtitle: [ES] An extra layer of protection on your account.

content.text: [ES] Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds a second verification step when you sign in, so your account stays protected even if your password is compromised.
[ES] 2FA is currently switched on for you by our team rather than self-service.

items: [ES] Open Support and raise a request.
[ES] Ask for two-factor authentication on your account.
[ES] Follow the setup instructions support sends you.

sections.heading: [ES] If you lose your second factor

content.text: [ES] Contact support as soon as you can. We'll verify your identity and help you get back in.
